messages.operatorGuidance: This is current evidence, not a historical failure cause or live Notify delivery status. Notify acceptance is recorded; this does not confirm recipient delivery. Check Notify by notification ID/reference. If still processing, wait. If delivered, redrive only to clean up the terminal queue copy without another send. If Notify later reports delivery failed, investigate; the record remains accepted and redrive still performs terminal-copy cleanup only. Check existing replacements and their progress. After checking Notify and investigating a confirmed delivery failure, explicit resend requests the one stable replacement. An inconclusive lookup leaves a duplicate-email risk.

availableActions.description: Clean up the terminal queue copy without another send
Request the one stable replacement after checking Notify and existing replacements
